summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on a discrepancy in how inventory data is updated. When retrieving inventory, the system correctly pulls data from both 'box' and 'lidar'. However, when updating (putting) the inventory, only 'facility' and 'assets' are being saved, neglecting the 'box' and 'lidar' information that is visible on the front end.

It was agreed that [p1] will locate where the missing 'box' and 'lidar' data needs to be added within the update function. [me] acknowledged this oversight and stated that implementing the full logic, including complex case checking (e.g., box relocation) and user access rights validation (to prevent unauthorized assignment of assets belonging to other companies), would be completed sometime during the week.
decisions: [p1] will locate where 'box' and 'lidar' data needs to be saved in the put function.
action_items: [me] to implement the full inventory update logic, including access rights checks, this week.
